card.name: End of heading terms and contraception advice
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'Associated Diarrhea' in C. difficile headings, and the word after 'reproductive potential' in contraception advice. It also fires on the end of other section-heading terms.

modes.label: C. difficile diarrhea heading
modes.description: Final piece of 'Diarrhea' in the Clostridioides difficile associated diarrhea heading.
modes.example: 5.3 Clostridioides difficile Associated Diarr<<hea>> Clostridioides difficile associated diarrhea

modes.label: Contraception advice
modes.description: 'to' or 'must' right after 'males with female partners of reproductive potential'.
modes.example: Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential<< to>> use effective contraception during treatment with deferip

modes.label: Other heading endings
modes.description: Last piece of a warning heading term such as Hyperglycemia or Adverse Reactions.
modes.example: 5.9 Diabetes Mellitus/Hyperglyc<<emia>> New onset diabetes mellitus, exacerbation

card.writes: It suppresses words like involved, associated and responsible, so it seems to steer away from those after a finished term.
card.plain: It marks the end of a warning heading or a stock contraception sentence, where the next words are fixed.
